text:
Gather together different bottles that can be filled with water.

Order them from largest to smallest capacity (volume of water they can hold).

Use a measuring jug to check your order.

Extension: use the words double, half, more, less, similar, three times, 1/3 to compare the different bottles. E.g. “The capacity of the coke can is one third of the capacity of the milk bottle”
